rules.sentence: Also, it is postulated that there is a risk of contracting a multidrug-resistant infection in patients with comorbidities, hospitalizations in ICUs, prior use of antibiotics, and prolonged use of a central venous catheter.[20]

The findings of gram-negative infections are non-specific, not distinguishing them from other infectious diseases on physical examination.
